Sync.Name: Automated Animations entries
Sync.Label: Review and sync
Sync.Hint: Add, update or remove the entries this module puts in the Automated Animations global menus.

SyncMode.Name: When the module has changes
SyncMode.Hint: What happens when a GM loads the world and there are entries to add, update or remove.

Sync.Title: More D&D5e Animations
Sync.Intro: Adds presets that D&D5e Animations lacks: the pt-BR names of its items and hand-picked presets for items it does not cover. Each entry copies a D&D5e Animations entry from this world, so edits to that entry carry over.
Sync.Summary: {add} to add, {update} to update, {remove} to remove.
Sync.Done: More D&D5e Animations: {add} added, {update} updated, {remove} removed.
Sync.SkippedExists: Skipped: another entry already has this name
Sync.SkippedModified: Skipped: edited in Automated Animations (kept as is)
Sync.IgnoredHint: One name per line. These entries are removed and never added again.
